method.value: The poster, a partnerships lead at a Series A SaaS, stopped asking Claude to generate outreach from scratch. Instead, they wrote a rough four-sentence draft themselves, pasted it into Claude, and asked for the single thing making it sound like a cold email; Claude flagged one issue such as a generic opener or premature calendar link, and the poster fixed it manually before sending.

outcome.value: They say this workflow changed their cold partner outreach from 0 replies to about a 16% reply rate over three months. The limit they stress is that letting Claude rewrite the whole email still makes it sound obviously AI-written.

notes.value: Their volume was low—about one new cold partner email and three follow-ups a week—so this was an editing aid, not a fully automated outreach system.

source_text.body:
Draft B2B partnership outreach emails that don't sound like AI
A poster used Claude for partnership outreach, having it flag what sounded like a cold email, and says their reply rate improved.
·
Jun 21, 2026
Done with
CL
Claude
What they did
The poster, a partnerships lead at a Series A SaaS, stopped asking Claude to generate outreach from scratch. Instead, they wrote a rough four-sentence draft themselves, pasted it into Claude, and asked for the single thing making it sound like a cold email; Claude flagged one issue such as a generic opener or premature calendar link, and the poster fixed it manually before sending.
How it went
They say this workflow changed their cold partner outreach from 0 replies to about a 16% reply rate over three months. The limit they stress is that letting Claude rewrite the whole email still makes it sound obviously AI-written.
Worth knowing
Their volume was low—about one new cold partner email and three follow-ups a week—so this was an editing aid, not a fully automated outreach system.
Try it yourself
with
Claude
Copy prompt
I'm writing a partnership outreach email to [type of company/role] about [partnership idea]. Here is my draft: [paste draft]. Rewrite it so it sounds like a real person wrote it, and first flag any phrases that sound like a generic cold email or AI-written text and explain why. Give me two final versions of under [100] words each, with a clear, low-pressure ask at the end.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/ClaudeAI/comments/1u31s1i/how_i_use_claude_for_b2b_partnership_outreach
